description: ARPA-I INSIGHTS Dataset is an open dataset on Amazon S3 listed in Registry of Open Data on AWS, a registry of open datasets hosted on Amazon S3 under the section "transportation", published or maintained by MIT Lincoln Laboratory. The ARPA-I INSIGHTS Dataset is a large-scale, high-density (~85 pts/m²) geiger-mode aerial LiDAR dataset covering over 1,600 km² across the Salt Lake City, UT and Denver, CO metropolitan regions, including major freeway corridors. Coverage: as stated on the registry page. The registry lists it under the tag transportation and hosts it on Amazon S3. Update frequency: Ad Hoc. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (as given on the registry page). Caveats: this record was written from the registry page, which was read; the data on S3 were not opened, the licence text was shortened, and the description may lag the source. It can support data-driven infrastructure planning and analysis. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-registry-of-open-data-on-aws.
